sources.evidence: MAK's current official page identifies the MAK Euro Cement Factory in Dalanjargalan Soum, Dornogovi Province, commissioned in 2017, as a fully automated dry-process cement factory. It states annual capacity of 1,070,000 tonnes of cement, 1,000,000 tonnes of clinker and 100,000 tonnes of lime, and identifies SRC and WRC special-purpose cement.
MAK's current building-materials page lists the MAK Euro Cement and Lime Factory as a current manufacturing operation and explicitly describes it as a dry-process cement factory.

name: Carthage Cement plant at Jebel Ressas

sources.evidence: Carthage Cement's current official cement page states that the company manufactures cement and documents the complete current dry-process production cycle from raw-material extraction through clinker production and cement grinding; the same page lists current cement and clinker products including CEM II/A-L 42.5 N, CEM I 42.5 N, CEM I 42.5 N-SR3, CEM II/A-L 32.5 N, Clinker SR and Clinker OPC.
Carthage Cement's official plant notice states that first clinker was produced at the Carthage Cement plant at Jebel Ressas on 1 October 2013.

The company's 2024 annual report, published on its official site, states that Carthage Cement currently manufactures hydraulic binders and operates a cement plant with 5,800 tonnes/day clinker production capacity.

Shayona Cement's current official homepage explicitly states that it has a cement manufacturing plant in Kasungu District and that it manufactures Akshar Cement, Buildplast Cement and Thanthwe Cement 42.5R; the page also identifies the Kasungu factory as an active operation.

The current official about page states that Shayona Cement Corporation Limited is a cement manufacturer and that its first Akshar and Buildplast cement brands were launched from the Kasungu District manufacturing plant; it also reports current manufacturing capacity of 1,600 tonnes/day and three cement brands.
Shayona Cement's official Akshar product page explicitly identifies Shayona Cement Corporation Limited as the manufacturer of Akshar Cement and lists the company's current cement portfolio.

name: Fábrica de Sequele - Nova Cimangola II

sources.evidence: Nova Cimangola's current official history identifies Fábrica de Sequele - Nova Cimangola II, states that it was inaugurated in 2017 to reinforce cement production capacity, and explicitly states that the factory has its own clinker production.
Nova Cimangola's current homepage lists the Sequele factory and states that the company is a cement producer in Angola.
Nova Cimangola's current official products page lists its cement portfolio, including CEM II/A-M (S-V-L) 42.5 N, CEM I 42.5 R, CEM I 52.5 N, CEM II/A-L 42.5 N and CEM II/B-L 32.5 N.
